主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by the Royal Bank of Canada, published on January 13, 2015. It is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes the Charter of the Board of Directors as Exhibit 99.1. The report is submitted under Form 40-F, indicating compliance with U.S. securities regulations. The filing is signed by Karen E. McCarthy, Vice-President, Associate General Counsel & Secretary, on behalf of the Royal Bank of Canada.
